errors.text_span: and the slices appear arranged roughly from the largest segment (Moive) through smaller segments around the ring
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the slices are arranged from largest to smallest. The actual clockwise order of slices by percentage is 41.2%, 14.9%, 30.5%, 9.1%, 4.3%. The second slice (14.9%) is smaller than the third (30.5%), so the order is not descending.
